name: prof-original
cmd: set -o pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && mkdir -p prof && GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 GDP_COUNTS_TRACE=1 GDP_COUNTS_PROF=1 timeout -s KILL 90 bun --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-md --cpu-prof-dir=prof --cpu-prof-interval=2000 research/protocols/ic3syn/run.ts --ms 60000 --only mldr --skip broken > run.out 2> run.err; echo EXIT $?; grep -v 'counts: try' run.err | grep '\[infer\]\|\[infer join\|counts: prof\|counts: candidates at\|counts: small\|finite Houdini' | cut -c1-300; echo PROFILE; ls -la prof; f=$(ls prof/*.md | head -1); head -c 70000 "$f"

name: prof-generation
cmd: set -o pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && mkdir -p prof && GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 120 bun --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-md --cpu-prof-dir=prof --cpu-prof-interval=2000 research/track-gen/t13-generation.ts mldr > gen.out 2> gen.err; echo EXIT $?; grep -v 'T13_DATA' gen.err | grep '\[infer\]\|\[infer join\|"phases"' | cut -c1-400; echo PROFILE; f=$(ls prof/*.md | head -1); head -c 70000 "$f"
